feed.title: Glyph releases
feed.subtitle: What changed in each release of Glyph, newest first.

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.186
entry.summary: Calls inside an @example are call sites

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.185 (breaking)
entry.summary: A function value's parameters are compared, and function types are printed

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.184 (breaking)
entry.summary: An index read has its element's type

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.183 (breaking)
entry.summary: bigint is its own type

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.182 (breaking)
entry.summary: A primitive and an interface are compared

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.181 (breaking)
entry.summary: The arguments of a mut method call are checked

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.180 (breaking)
entry.summary: A lost update across an await is caught on elements and map entries too

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.179 (breaking)
entry.summary: A value written by mut is checked against the place it goes into

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.178
entry.summary: A deprecated built-in method draws a warning with its replacement

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.177 (breaking)
entry.summary: A sort of numbers needs a comparator

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.176 (breaking)
entry.summary: An unknown value is refused where another type is declared

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.175 (breaking)
entry.summary: is Array and is Record arms narrow their value

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.174 (breaking)
entry.summary: A block's last expression is checked against the declared return

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.173 (breaking)
entry.summary: A generic bound is resolved, and a bounded T is checked as its bound

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.172 (breaking)
entry.summary: Inside a generic function, its own T is a type of its own

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.171
entry.summary: Each type parameter knows the declaration it belongs to

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.170 (breaking)
entry.summary: A second name for a type gives the same answer as the plain spelling

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.169 (breaking)
entry.summary: An escape inside the ${} of a "..." string is a parse error

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.168 (breaking)
entry.summary: A loop over an array literal binds the element type

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.167 (breaking)
entry.summary: Writes to a Set, Store or Deque are mut statements, like array writes

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.166 (breaking)
entry.summary: An unannotated const has the type of its value

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.165 (breaking)
entry.summary: A literal can only name fields its type declares

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.164
entry.summary: Positions inside ${} point at the text they name

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.163 (breaking)
entry.summary: The stdlib Set, Store and Deque are typed, and an empty deque can't hand back undefined

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.162 (breaking)
entry.summary: A ?? on an Option is refused, and glyph fix stops writing inside ${}

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.161 (breaking)
entry.summary: A method that returns undefined when nothing is there is refused, and the Option form is named

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.160 (breaking)
entry.summary: A call that changes an array is written as a mut statement

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.159 (breaking)
entry.summary: An async callback passed where nothing will wait for it is an error

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.158 (breaking)
entry.summary: A lambda parameter without an annotation takes its type from where the lambda is passed

entry.title: Glyph 0.1.157 (breaking)
entry.summary: A value with no text form can't be turned into text by accident
